title: CRPO: Confidence-Reward Driven Preference Optimization for Machine Translation
authors_zh: Guofeng Cui, Pichao Wang, Yang Liu, Zemian Ke, Zhu Liu, Vimal Bhat
paper_type_zh: 置信度与奖励联合的偏好数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 适合构造翻译偏好对，并需要区分高质量样本与当前模型仍能从中学习的样本的读者。
one_line: CRPO selects translation preference pairs with both reward contrast and model uncertainty, concentrating DPO on records with higher learning value.
CRPO 同时依据奖励差距与模型置信度选择翻译偏好对，让 DPO 聚焦仍有学习价值的记录。
why: It makes model confidence a selection signal alongside reward, so preference data is chosen for expected learning value rather than quality alone.
inclusion_reason: It chooses translation preference records according to both quality separation and the current model's uncertainty, directly changing which pairs DPO consumes.

title: Problem
问题
html:
DPO quality depends on which translation preference pairs it consumes. Reward-only filters can retain high-quality pairs that the current model already handles confidently.

CRPO asks which pairs are both well separated in quality and still informative for the model. It treats confidence as a second selection signal.

DPO 的质量依赖它消费哪些翻译偏好对。只看奖励的过滤器可能保留高质量、但当前模型已能自信处理的样本。

CRPO 要回答的是，哪些样本既有清晰质量差异、又仍对模型有信息价值。它把置信度作为第二个选择信号。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
CRPO combines reward contrast with policy confidence. High reward difference says a pair has a clear preference; low confidence says the model is likely to learn from it.

The selected set therefore targets difficult or underperforming translation cases, rather than maximizing reward separation alone.

CRPO 结合奖励对比与策略置信度。高奖励差表示偏好清晰；低置信度表示模型可能仍能从中学习。

所选集合因而针对困难或表现欠佳的翻译情形，而不是只最大化奖励差异。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper samples candidate translations, scores them with a reward model, and obtains reference-policy likelihoods. A confidence-reward score ranks candidate pairs for DPO.

The reported construction uses 3,065 FLORES-200 sources and 64 candidates per source. It compares CRPO with RSO, RS-DPO, and existing triplet data.

论文采样候选翻译，用奖励模型评分，并取得参考策略似然。置信度—奖励分数为候选对排序，供 DPO 使用。

所报告的构造使用 3,065 个 FLORES-200 源句和每句 64 个候选。它将 CRPO 与 RSO、RS-DPO 及既有三元组数据比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
CRPO is evaluated over ten translation directions and on both ALMA-7B and NLLB-1.3B. The paper reports better translation accuracy and data efficiency than RSO, RS-DPO, and MBR-score baselines.

It also compares selection formulations and runs significance tests. The evidence is translation-specific and depends on the reward and confidence estimates used to construct the pair set.

CRPO 在十个翻译方向上评测，并覆盖 ALMA-7B 和 NLLB-1.3B。论文报告它在翻译准确率和数据效率上优于 RSO、RS-DPO 和 MBR 分数基线。

它还比较选择公式并运行显著性检验。证据是翻译专用的，并依赖构造样本对时采用的奖励与置信度估计。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The new decision is to select preference pairs by expected learning value, not reward margin alone. Model confidence makes the pair score relative to the current policy.

This turns translation preference construction into a joint quality-and-learnability filter.

新的决定是按预期学习价值选择偏好对，而不只按奖励差。模型置信度使样本分数相对于当前策略而变化。

这把翻译偏好构造变成质量与可学习性联合过滤。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The score depends on reward-model calibration and reference-policy confidence. It is tested on translation and no official code or selected-pair release is declared.
该分数依赖奖励模型校准和参考策略置信度。它在翻译上测试，且没有声明官方代码或所选样本对发布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use CRPO when reward differences alone create many easy preference pairs. It can prioritize examples where the model remains uncertain, but validate its scores for the target language direction.
当只看奖励差会产生许多容易偏好对时，可使用 CRPO。它能优先选择模型仍不确定的例子，但应验证其分数在目标语言方向上的有效性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read CRPO as a pair-selection rule before DPO. Inspect reward separation and confidence jointly; either one alone can choose data with limited training value.
应把 CRPO 视为 DPO 之前的样本对选择规则。请同时检查奖励差与置信度；单独使用任一项都可能选择训练价值有限的数据。
